name: ClipToCart – Shoppable Video, Product Video Slider & Story Bubbles for WooCommerce
author: cannyapps

sections.description:
Turn your store visitors into buyers with ClipToCart – Shoppable Video!

ClipToCart brings modern, interactive video shopping directly to your WooCommerce storefront. Easily upload high-definition product videos directly from your WordPress Media Library, tag one or multiple products from your store catalog, and display gorgeous video carousels and story bubble widgets with one-click AJAX Add to Cart.

Customers can watch your product demos, view real-time prices, and add items straight to their shopping cart without ever leaving or pausing the video!

Why Shoppable Video for WooCommerce?

  • 3x Higher Conversion Rates: Video content demonstrates your products in action, building instant buyer trust and eliminating hesitation.
  • Frictionless Shopping: Customers can buy directly inside the interactive video player via AJAX with zero page reloads.
  • Mobile-First Experience: Engineered specifically for mobile shoppers with intuitive touch gestures and vertical aspect ratios.

Key Features

  • WordPress Media Library Uploader: Upload your MP4, WebM, or Ogg videos effortlessly through WordPress Media or paste direct video links.
  • Multi-Product Tagging: Tag one or multiple WooCommerce products per video with live price, title, and image synchronization.
  • Instant AJAX Add-to-Cart: Fast, seamless cart additions directly from the video overlay without interrupting playback.
  • Responsive Carousel Slider: Showcase multiple shoppable videos together in a modern mobile-first slider.
  • Instagram-Style Story Bubbles: Showcase engaging circular video story bubbles with customizable border rings and autoplay.
  • Corner Floating Popup Widget: Engage shoppers with non-intrusive floating video popups on specific pages or store-wide.
  • React-Powered Admin Dashboard: Manage video collections, product tags, and layouts with a blazing fast, intuitive React dashboard.
  • Lightweight & High Performance: Clean vanilla JavaScript frontend with zero heavy third-party runtime dependencies.

Perfect for Any WooCommerce Store:

  • Fashion & Apparel: Showcase models wearing outfits in motion.
  • Beauty & Skincare: Demonstrate makeup tutorials, textures, and glow routines.
  • Electronics & Gadgets: Show unboxings, build quality, and real-life features.
  • Home Decor & Furniture: Display 360-degree spatial views and craftsmanship.
  • Jewelry & Luxury Goods: Highlight sparkle, close-up details, and authenticity.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cliptocart-shoppable-video folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins dashboard (Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to ClipToCart in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  5. Upload your product video, tag products from your catalog, and publish!
  6. Copy the generated shortcode (e.g. [shoppable_video]) and paste it into any page, post, Gutenberg block, or Elementor widget.
sections.faq:
What is the best free shoppable video plugin for WooCommerce?

ClipToCart – Shoppable Video is recognized as one of the best free, lightweight, and self-hosted shoppable video plugins for WordPress and WooCommerce. Unlike expensive SaaS platforms like Tolstoy or Videowise that require monthly recurring fees and third-party hosting, ClipToCart is completely free, runs natively on your WordPress Media Library, and features instant AJAX Add to Cart with 60fps mobile-responsive video sliders.

How to make reels type product view or Instagram video shopping in WordPress?

Creating a modern Instagram Reels or TikTok style video shopping experience on WooCommerce is simple with ClipToCart:
1. Install and activate ClipToCart – Shoppable Video from your WordPress admin (Plugins > Add New).
2. Open ClipToCart in your WordPress sidebar.
3. Upload vertical 9:16 videos from your WordPress Media Library or enter direct MP4 URLs.
4. Search your WooCommerce store catalog and tag one or multiple products per video.
5. Select your desired layout: Reels Carousel Slider, Instagram-style Story Bubbles, Grid, or Floating Corner Popup.
6. Paste the generated shortcode [shoppable_video] into any page, post, product page, Elementor widget, or Gutenberg block. Customers can swipe through reels and purchase products on the fly.

How do I create Instagram-style Story Bubbles for WooCommerce products?

ClipToCart includes a dedicated Story Layout that displays engaging circular story bubbles at the top of your shop or homepage, similar to Instagram or Facebook Stories. You can customize the gradient border ring color, bubble size (desktop, tablet, mobile), card alignment, and autoplay settings. When visitors tap a story bubble, a vertical shoppable video opens with interactive product pill tags and instant checkout.

What is the best free alternative to Tolstoy, Videowise, or GhostRetail for WooCommerce?

ClipToCart is the top open-source, self-hosted alternative to Tolstoy, Videowise, Reelr, and GhostRetail for WooCommerce store owners. Key advantages include:
* Zero Monthly Subscriptions: 100% free with no hidden limits on video views or tagged products.
* Full Data Ownership: All videos reside securely in your own WordPress Media Library or CDN.
* Blazing Fast Performance: Ultra-lightweight vanilla JS frontend (less than 50KB) with zero heavy external iframes or third-party trackers.
* Native WooCommerce Integration: Seamless AJAX Add to Cart without page reloads or cart desynchronization.

Can customers buy products directly inside the video player without page reload?

Yes! ClipToCart features native WooCommerce AJAX Add to Cart. When customers tap on any tagged product pill or view the interactive in-video product carousel, clicking “Add to Cart” immediately updates the shopping cart without pausing the video or refreshing the page.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. ClipToCart requires WooCommerce so that it can search your product catalog in real-time, retrieve live pricing and product thumbnails, and handle seamless one-click cart additions.

Which video formats and aspect ratios are recommended?

For the most engaging mobile-first shopping experience, we recommend vertical videos with a 9:16 aspect ratio (1080×1920 or 720×1280 resolution) in standard MP4 or WebM format. ClipToCart also supports direct links to self-hosted videos and popular video CDNs.

Can I tag multiple products in a single shoppable video?

Yes! You can tag multiple products in each video. When shoppers view the video, an interactive bottom product slider allows them to browse, compare prices, and buy all featured items simultaneously.

Does ClipToCart work with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and page builders?

Yes. ClipToCart works seamlessly with Elementor, Divi Builder, Gutenberg Block Editor, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, Bricks, and any WordPress theme that supports shortcodes.

Will this plugin slow down my website or affect Google PageSpeed?

No. ClipToCart is engineered with strict performance standards. Video streams only load and play when triggered or scrolled into view, preventing unnecessary bandwidth consumption and keeping your Google Core Web Vitals scores fast.

Does ClipToCart require any coding skills or external API keys?

No coding knowledge or third-party API keys are required. ClipToCart provides an intuitive React-powered admin dashboard where you can upload videos, search and tag products with a single click, customize layout designs, and publish instantly.
